fact: The enumeration phase of the third census (RGPH-3) began on 20 June 2026, seventeen years after the 2009 operation, and the closing date was pushed to 21 July 2026.
title: Tchad : En route vers l'avenir, le 3ème Recensement Général de la Population et de l'Habitation (RGPH-3) bat son plein malgré les défis!
